tagline: Connecting people and businesses through advanced mobility and fiber networks
hero_kpi_rationale: The Mobility segment is the primary driver of revenue and operating income growth, representing approximately 74% of total Communications segment revenue. It is the central pillar of AT&T's growth strategy, with a 5% increase in 2025.

kpis.name: Mobility Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from mobile services and equipment for postpaid, prepaid, and MVNO customers.
kpis.description: Mobility revenue increased by 5.0% in 2025, driven by growth in postpaid services (+3.1%) and equipment (+11.1%).
kpis.signal: Solid core business growth despite market maturity.

kpis.name: Consumer Wireline Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from broadband, fiber, and fixed-line telephony services for residential customers.
kpis.description: Driven by fiber adoption and multi-gig services, this segment offsets the decline in legacy services.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth due to fiber deployment.

kpis.name: Business Wireline Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from fixed services (fiber, IP, managed services) for enterprise customers.
kpis.description: The segment is losing ground due to declining demand for traditional fixed services.
kpis.signal: Marked decline in legacy services despite transformation efforts.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved due to lower impairment charges (including Business Wireline goodwill in 2024) and cost discipline.
kpis.signal: Strong improvement following a 2024 impacted by write-downs.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Capital expenditures for network development (fiber, 5G, Open RAN).
kpis.description: Capex remains high to support fiber deployment and mobile network modernization (Open RAN).

kpis.name: Postpaid Churn
kpis.explanation: Percentage of postpaid customers canceling their contract each month.
kpis.description: Churn rate increased slightly, rising from 0.92% in 2024 to 1.05% in 2025.

kpis.name: Postpaid Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Total number of paying mobile customers (smartphones, tablets, wearables).
kpis.description: AT&T added 1.7 million new postpaid subscribers in 2025, despite increased competition.
kpis.signal: Moderate but stable growth in core customer base.

kpis.name: Communications Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue from the Communications segment, including Mobility, Business Wireline, and Consumer Wireline.
kpis.description: The Communications segment represents 97% of AT&T's total revenue, growing 2.8% in 2025.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by Mobility and Consumer Wireline.

kpis.name: Mobility Net Additions
kpis.explanation: Net number of new mobile subscribers added during the year (postpaid, prepaid, reseller).
kpis.description: Net additions fell to 2.3 million in 2025 from 4.2 million in 2024, reflecting market saturation.

kpis.name: Postpaid Phone Net Additions
kpis.explanation: Net number of new postpaid smartphone subscribers.
kpis.description: AT&T continues to attract premium customers, but at a slower pace than in 2024.

kpis.name: DIRECTV Gain
kpis.explanation: Gain realized from the sale of the investment in DIRECTV in July 2025.
kpis.description: The sale of DIRECTV generated a non-taxable exceptional gain of $5.6 billion, significantly boosting 2025 net income.
kpis.signal: Major transaction transforming the financial structure.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).
